title: Are LLMs Enough for Hyperpartisan, Fake, Polarized and Harmful Content Detection? Evaluating In-Context Learning vs. Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification performance (F1 score and Accuracy) on identifying the political leaning (e.g., Left, Center, Right) and hyperpartisanship of news articles and headlines using both fine-tuning and various in-context learning strategies (zero-shot, few-shot, codebook, and Chain-of-Thought).
